title: Ester Alongi
text:
Welcome to my website!
My name is Ester Alongi. I am a second-year PhD candidate in Statistical Science at the University of Padua, supervised by Gianmarco Altoè. I completed my Bachelor’s degree in Statistics at the University of Milano-Bicocca and my Master’s degree in Statistics at the University of Padua, under the supervision of Bruno Scarpa.
I am currently a visiting researcher at the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute and at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, working under Giovanni Parmigiani.
My research focuses on the methodological side of statistics, with current interests in replicability, Bayesian analysis, causal inference and mediation analysis, and applications to psychological and genomics research.

title: Ester Alongi
text:
Highlights
In my research, I work towards having easy-to-use software that can be useful to scientists in my field as well as in others. Below is a list of tutorials for packages I developed in parallel with some of my projects.


R-packages









BayesANT - BAYESiAn Nonparametric Taxonomic classifier
BayesANT is a DNA barcoding algorithm to classify DNA sequences within a hierarchical taxonomy, while allowing novel species to be discovered in the test set. See Zito, Rigon, Dunson (2023) MEE.
GitHub Tutorial













BNPvegan - Bayesian nonparametric methods for ecologists
BNPvegan is an R-package that implements the methods described in Zito, Rigon, Ovaskainen and Dunson (2023) JASA
GitHub Tutorial













ConjugateDP - random number generator for the Stirling-gamma distribution
ConjugateDP is an R-package that implements the random sampler for the Stirling-gamma distribution, which is the conjugate prior for the Dirichlet process precision parameter. See methods described in Zito, Rigon, Dunson (2024) BA
GitHub













CompressiveNMF - Bayesian non-negative matrix factorization for mutational signature analysis
This repo contains the code to reproduce the empirical results in Zito and Miller (2024+) arXiv
GitHub






Other projects









Proximity - Pareto optimal proxy metrics
This repo contains the code to reproduce the empirical results in Richarson et al. (2023), arXiv
